title: Email delivery bugs found by the ADR-002 review
goal: Every email the product says it sends is actually sent, delivery events reach the screens, bounces never destroy data, and replies reach the agency.
why: docs/decisions/ADR-002-email.md (2026-10-21) found five bugs that exist with SendGrid today, independent of the provider decision.
steps: Save the provider message id on every outbound email row (email log / campaign recipient / message) so the event webhook can find it; opens, clicks, bounces and spam reports then update the rows and the campaign screens.
"Send itinerary by email": the email queue must recognise and send the job it is given (today it drops it).
Invoice and voucher "send": actually send the email (with the PDF or link, through the Communication Hub path and templates), not only change the status.
A hard bounce must not erase the contact's email address: mark it undeliverable (flag + reason + date) and suppress further sends; show it on the contact.
Inbox / Communication Hub emails: set reply-to to the sending user or the agency's reply address so customer replies reach the agency.
Keep the provider behind the existing send function (no provider switch in this batch; ADR-002 is awaiting the owner).
tests: each of the five bugs has a failing-then-passing test
acceptance: all five behaviours proven by tests; existing campaign/unsubscribe tests unchanged
gate: desktop tsc + vitest + lint-gate + i18n-check if desktop touched
e2e: invoices, vouchers, itineraries, campaigns, communication-inbox on a local stack
goLiveVerify: real SendGrid event webhook delivering to the API
